question: Which Indian naval ship visited Port Louis, Mauritius, in March 2025 to participate in the 57th National Day celebrations?​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **INS Imphal** visited Port Louis, Mauritius, in March 2025 to participate in the 57th National Day celebrations of Mauritius.
 
• The visit of INS Imphal underlines the strong bilateral relations between India and Mauritius, particularly in the maritime domain.
 
• The ship's deployment was part of India's commitment to promoting maritime security and cooperation in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• INS Imphal is an indigenously built stealth destroyer of the Indian Navy, equipped with advanced weaponry and sensors.
 
• Such visits enhance diplomatic ties and foster collaboration in defense, culture, and trade between both nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **INS Imphal:**

 
 
• It is a Project 15B class stealth guided-missile destroyer commissioned by the Indian Navy.
 
• The ship is equipped with state-of-the-art sensors and weapons, including BrahMos missiles and indigenous systems.
 
• It is designed to operate in multi-threat environments and is capable of undertaking a variety of missions.
 
 
 
• **India-Mauritius Relations:**
 
 
• India and Mauritius share strong cultural, economic, and strategic ties, with Mauritius being a key partner in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• India has been actively involved in supporting Mauritius in various sectors, including defense, infrastructure, and health.
 
• Bilateral naval exercises like the "SAMUDRA SHAKTI" enhance maritime cooperation between the two nations.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean Region (IOR):**
 
 
• The IOR is a strategically important region with significant trade routes and geopolitical influence.
 
• India plays a pivotal role in ensuring maritime security and stability in the region through collaborations and naval deployments.
 
 
 
• **National Day Celebrations in Mauritius:**
 
 
• The National Day of Mauritius is celebrated on March 12th every year to mark its independence from British rule in 1968.
 
• The event is significant for showcasing the nation's achievements and fostering international partnerships.
